- Total revenue TW reached £50.3k, up 21.8% WoW from £41.3k LW, demonstrating strong week-on-week growth across the product portfolio.
- REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER generated £2.5k revenue TW and led order volume with 53 orders, making it the top-performing product by order count.
- WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER achieved £2.2k revenue TW with 785 units sold and 55 orders, the highest order count across all products.
- JUMBO BAG RED RETROSPOT contributed £1.4k revenue TW from 751 units across 40 orders, ranking third in revenue generation.
- FLAG OF ST GEORGE CAR FLAG showed exceptional growth with revenue up 3969.8% WoW, followed by BLACK HEART CARD HOLDER at 3930.0% WoW growth.
- ASSORTED COLOURS SILK FAN led unit sales with 1571 units TW, while ASSORTED FLOWER COLOUR "LEIS" achieved 1098 units and SMALL CHINESE STYLE SCISSOR reached 1000 units.
- Total unit volume TW reached 22179 units across 1661 orders, indicating strong customer engagement and transaction frequency.
- NATURAL SLATE HEART CHALKBOARD and JUMBO BAG SCANDINAVIAN PAISLEY both demonstrated substantial WoW revenue growth at 2940.5% and 2749.3% respectively.
